measured: lab pipeline: meshopt simplify (sloppy fallback for photo-scans), textures resized and Basis ETC1S KTX2, EXT_meshopt_compression; previews rendered in three r128 with the same loaders the game would use

candidates.name: Boulder 01
candidates.author: Rico Cilliers
candidates.notes: Real photo-scan; reads as a rock from above. Replaces the displaced-sphere boulders.

candidates.name: Namaqualand boulder 02
candidates.author: Greg Zaal, Rico Cilliers
candidates.notes: Layered desert boulder; good for Desert Highway and Red Canyon.

candidates.name: Mossy rock set 01
candidates.author: Kless Gyzen
candidates.notes: Six small stones in one file; scatter around jungle and harbour.

candidates.name: Rock 09
candidates.author: Jenelle van Heerden
candidates.notes: Tall cliff-side rock; good on slopes.

candidates.name: Free Sci-Fi Fighter
candidates.author: GrafxBOX / CGPitbull
candidates.attribution: "Free Sci Fi Fighter" by GrafxBOX / CGPitbull (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-sci-fi-fighter-dca1c832ee574e2fa2cdaa06515f66a9), CC Attribution
candidates.notes: Clean, readable silhouette from above; light (2.6k tris, 3 textures). Good enemy interceptor. CC-BY: credit needed.

candidates.name: Futured Jet Plane
candidates.author: OzerGokmen
candidates.attribution: "Futured Jet Plane" by OzerGokmen (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/futured-jet-plane-b7319454acbe4fe7a09f32c847d1a8c0), CC Attribution
candidates.notes: Bright striped livery and 27 separate textures (~36 MB GPU even compressed). Would need a texture atlas in Blender and a repaint to fit Skyfire.

candidates.name: Sci-fi Tank Doodad
candidates.author: TooManyDemons
candidates.attribution: "Scifi Tank Doodad" by TooManyDemons (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scifi-tank-doodad-0ef0619189de4a32b6972e63cb6adec0), CC Attribution
candidates.notes: Despite the name it is a generator / fuel-tank prop, not a combat tank. Could serve as base clutter only.

candidates.name: Heavy VTOL gunship
candidates.author: Kai Xiang
candidates.attribution: "Heavy VTOL gunship" by Kai Xiang (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/heavy-vtol-gunship-86d336e0fa6f40329de8cda4a71d8a17), CC Attribution
candidates.notes: Strong shape but the camouflage blurs from above, and 34 textures (~45 MB GPU). Needs atlas + recolour.

candidates.license: CC0 (dual CC-BY 3.0; author: no credit needed)
